# Fray

> Poll-driven Rust transport and session state machines for small realtime multiplayer games. The current wire supports up to eight player seats.

## Documentation

- [Integrate Fray](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Run the starter and add the transport loop to a Rust game.
- [Integration constraints](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray/blob/main/docs/coding-assistants.md): Transport rules and examples for changes made by coding agents.
- [Cargo packages and status](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray/blob/main/README.md): Source dependencies, supported paths and work in progress.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [friend-link-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/friend-link-kit): Game invitation and encrypted hello formats.
- [fray-relay-client](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray-relay-client): General-purpose Nostr relay client in Rust.
